source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_fans" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i fans (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the fan OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_fans SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read fan telemetry over SNMPv3 and verify each fan's state, speed and redundancy under a defined operating condition.
original_method: Engineer enables v3 and browses `$target`; no fan table or acceptance values are defined.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/v3; after mapping, automated telemetry sampling/comparison can run while engineering owns thermal safety.
safety_requirements: Read only; never alter fan policy or inject failure in this case.
Protect v3 secrets and reject v2c substitution.
Safety-stop on fan failure or thermal alarm.
Preserve timestamps/raw values; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, query each mapped fan and correlate speed/state/redundancy with reference telemetry.
Do not change cooling controls or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve fan map/state/thresholds and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic v2c grep cannot identify fan slots, speed units, status or redundancy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor fan-table SNMPv3 objects with full typed output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Sample mapped fan speed/state/PWM/redundancy under a defined load and correlate with BMC/Redfish/IPMI telemetry and thermal alarms.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds slot identity, operating state and redundancy acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing, stalled or mis-mapped fans.

project_override_considerations: Approved project thresholds may vary by fan zone and load; each override must record the applied fan/state matrix.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria switch clients while `$target` remains undefined; DeepSeek changes to v2c/generic subtree and supplies no fan semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan map/state/limits are project inputs. Once approved, manual setup followed by automated read-only monitoring is executable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects generic filter as fan evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Block is cooling semantics, not package availability.

review_improvement: Adds slot/redundancy mapping and thermal safety stop.
independent_technical_reasoning: A numeric speed is meaningful only when tied to a fan slot, expected control state and redundancy policy. Undefined `$target` prevents a safe, judgeable test.
